gaps: 应付账款 is disclosed only by aging (1年以内…5年以上), not by nature (货款/工程设备款 etc.), in every report. No by-nature split exists.

存货 categories disclosed are only 原材料, 在产品, 库存商品, 发出商品 and 半成品. No separate 周转材料, 委托加工物资 or 合同履约成本 lines are disclosed in any period, although the policy text mentions 委托加工物资. 半成品 first appears in FY2023; it is absent from the FY2022 comparative.

应收票据: the bad-debt provision tables are printed but blank for FY2023, FY2024 and 2025H1, and are omitted entirely from the FY2025 report. A provision appears only in 2026H1: 5% on commercial acceptance bills, 9,775,758.23 on a gross 195,515,164.43; bank acceptance bills carry nil. The 2026H1 ECL policy text is unchanged from FY2025, so this looks like first application of the 1年以内 5% rate to commercial bills. No aging of 应收票据 is disclosed.
应收款项融资 contains only 银行承兑汇票 in every period. No 应收账款 factoring or other composition is disclosed.
预付款项: 2026H1 discloses only the aggregate top-5 figure (94,135,602.50, 66.45%), not individual counterparties.

其他流动资产 contains no 定期存款 in any period. Fixed deposits and large-denomination CDs with maturity over one year sit in 其他非流动资产; they are now added as reference table other_noncurrent_assets_ref (FY2023 3,590,703,332.88; FY2024 2,930,250,491.63; FY2025 5,850,993,695.94; 2025H1 2,925,940,233.93; 2026H1 5,693,137,633.12). Deposits due within one year are in 货币资金 (see D2).
应付职工薪酬: no 辞退福利 or 其他一年内到期福利 balances are disclosed. Only short-term and DC plans exist.
应交税费 2026H1 has an unspecified '其他' line of 150,852.77 with no breakdown.

The FY2024 应收账款坏账准备 roll-forward does not foot with standard signs, and its 核销 (4,470.14) conflicts with the separate 实际核销 table (89,402.79). The FY2023 roll-forward foots only if its 汇率变动 (-223,532.10) is subtracted. Both are reported as disclosed; no corrected figures are available in the reports. Observation: 4,470.14 = 5% x 89,402.79 exactly. The roll-forward 核销 column therefore appears to show only the allowance attached to the written-off receivable (1年以内 5% bucket), not the gross write-off.
合同负债 aging and the 'revenue recognised from opening balance' amount are not disclosed in these notes. The 账龄超过1年的重要合同负债 tables are blank.
FY2022 figures (comparatives in the 2023 report) were not included except where needed as FY2023 期初 in roll-forwards.
policies: ECL policy (2025年年度报告 五、重要会计政策 金融工具减值, p92-93): receivables without a significant financing component use the simplified approach (lifetime ECL). Portfolio 1 is the aging portfolio (账龄组合). Portfolio 2 is the no-risk portfolio (无风险组合: 押金、保证金), which is generally not provided for. Aging ECL rates for 应收账款 are 1年以内 5%, 1-2年 10%, 2-3年 30%, 3年以上 90%. For 其他应收款 they are 5% / 10% / 30% / 80%. Other financial assets follow the same rates. Other financial assets use the three-stage general model.

Specific (单项) AR provisions are 100%. They cover Solydera GmbH 628,981.34 (bankrupt; 2023-2025 reports) plus FY2025 客户2 681,341.70 and 客户3 240,004.21 (counterparty cash-strapped). 客户3 was recovered or reversed in 2026H1 (收回或转回 240,004.21).

Inventory policy (2025年年度报告 五.11 存货, p94-95): categories are 原材料、半成品、库存商品、在产品、发出商品、委托加工物资. A perpetual inventory system is used; items are recorded at actual cost and issued at moving weighted-average cost (移动加权平均法). 周转材料 is amortised on a one-off basis (一次转销法). Inventory is carried at the lower of cost and NRV, with provisions made item by item. Numerous low-value items are provided for by category.

Bills: bills endorsed or discounted but not derecognised stay in 应收票据. Endorsed ones are offset by 其他流动负债 '未终止确认的已背书未到期的票据'; discounted ones by 短期借款 '未终止确认的已贴现未到期的票据'. Bank acceptance bills in 应收款项融资 are derecognised on endorsement or discount (期末终止确认金额 e.g. FY2025 911,392,111.12). The 应收款项融资 table carries a '累计在其他综合收益中确认的损失准备' column, which indicates FVOCI measurement (2025年报 附注七.5).

维修准备金 in 其他流动负债 (2025年年度报告 七.30 note *1) is a warranty provision at Vermes Microdispensing GmbH. It is based on historical in-warranty return rates, current-year unit sales and unit repair or replacement cost. In FY2023 a similar 维修准备金 of 2,530,872.48 was carried in 预计负债 (non-current).
Large-enterprise status: the 2025年年度报告 七.23 states the company is a large enterprise with no overdue payables to SMEs.
notes: All tables are consolidated (合并) notes. Every period's note totals were tied to the 合并资产负债表 line (应收票据, 应收账款, 应收款项融资, 预付款项, 其他应收款, 存货, 其他流动资产, 应付票据, 应付账款, 合同负债, 应付职工薪酬, 应交税费, 其他应付款, 其他流动负债). All tied.

Bills linkage (derived, exact): not-derecognised endorsed plus discounted bills in 应收票据 equal 其他流动负债 endorsed bills plus 短期借款 discounted bills in every period. FY2025: 255,484,993.54 + 295,094,028.42 = 550,579,021.96. 2026H1: 179,435,529.00 + 344,734,847.66 = 524,170,376.66. A model can therefore strip these gross-ups from both working capital and debt.

The AR allowance roll-forward '其他' column (FY2025 +410,253.57; 2025H1 +846,417.44; 2026H1 -773,267.69) is non-P&L. The FY2023 and FY2024 reports label the same column 汇率变动, so it is FX translation of overseas subsidiaries' allowances (Vermes group etc.). It is not a scope change: Vermes Microdispensing GmbH was already consolidated in FY2023, and the only FY2025 scope changes were the newly established 潮州三环环保科技有限责任公司 and the deregistered 德阳光胜贸易有限公司 (2025年报 九、合并范围的变更). P&L tie (信用减值损失-应收账款坏账损失, as disclosed, negative = loss): FY2023 -23,341,506.50; FY2024 -12,532,381.64; FY2025 -15,696,476.35; 2025H1 -4,573,334.87; 2026H1 -46,172,353.39. The P&L equals 本期计提 in FY2023-2025H1, but in 2026H1 it is net of the 240,004.21 reversal (46,412,357.60 - 240,004.21 = 46,172,353.39). The FY2024 P&L does not net the 21,734.88 收回或转回, consistent with that year's roll-forward footing anomaly. 2026H1 also has a new 应收票据坏账损失 of -9,775,758.23. See table impairment_pl_link.

Payroll: 本期增加 in 应付职工薪酬 gives total accrued employee cost. FY2023 1,427,964,997.24, FY2024 1,875,670,773.28, FY2025 2,102,380,310.90, 2025H1 907,608,123.54, 2026H1 1,124,698,243.08. The balance swings seasonally: year-end bonus accrual is paid down in H1 (2025H1 167.8m vs FY2024 347.7m).

上市费用 in 其他流动资产 (FY2025 10,201,078.92; 2026H1 15,360,513.52, labelled 预付上市费用) is capitalised H-share issuance cost. The 2025年报 (p12) states the company filed with HKEX for an H-share main-board listing. The 2026半年报 states the H shares listed on the HKEX main board on 2026-07-09 (80,221,200 H shares including the partial over-allotment exercise), which is after the 2026-06-30 balance-sheet date. These costs are therefore expected to be offset against share premium in 2026H2 rather than expensed. Related cash outflows appear in 支付的其他与筹资活动有关的现金-上市费用: FY2025 11,573,946.26 (2025年报 p140) and 2026H1 6,625,831.73.
The 2026H1 report merges 其他应付款 保证金 and 押金 into '押金、保证金' and folds 租金 into '其他'. The FY2025 comparative is restated accordingly (94,928,111.76 and 19,400,038.58).

Inventory provision economics (see impairment_pl_link): the P&L inventory write-down is far smaller than the gross 计提 in FY2023 (0.97m vs 21.77m) because of large reversals. Implied 转销 on sale or scrap is 49.0m in FY2023, 31.2m in FY2025 and 6.3m in 2026H1. 2026H1 shows a sharp step-up: 计提 58.69m, P&L -54.60m, provision/gross 4.03% vs 2.84% at FY2025, with the 在产品 provision more than doubling (10.18m to 23.04m) and the 半成品 provision nearly doubling (17.02m to 33.80m).

Other receivables mix (other_receivables_by_method): the 无风险组合 (押金、保证金) is 64-81% of gross after FY2023 and carries no provision, so the effective provision rate on 其他应收款 (about 1.4-2.2%) understates the rate on the 账龄组合 portion (about 6-9%).
